messages:
marta: Heads up — AsterMed renewal in 6 weeks. They asked for an SLO evidence bundle (uptime + 99th latency) before the renewal call.
ben: Got it. Do we have a standard artifact set we send? logs + dashboard + e2e traces?
olivia: CS playbook currently lists uptime pdf and SLA calc. Need examples for latency distributions + query snippet.
sam: I can assemble the queries. Which timeframe do they want? 30d or 90d?
marta: Customer asked for 30/90 day breakdown, plus incident annotations. Also show credit calc examples.
ben: I'll add an ops section on how credits are computed and a sample table.
playbook-bot: Reminder: playbook draft due in 48h for review :calendar: 
marta: @ben @sam can we make a minimal evidence bundle template? zip with: dashboard links, prometheus queries, logs export, incident list, credit calculation sheet.
ben: working on it now. snippet for 99th latency (PromQL):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[30d])) by (le))
```
ben: Also add rolling uptime calc: `sum(up{job="inference"})/count(up{job="inference"})` with daily granularity.
olivia: I'll update playbook docs and add a short intro section for CS so they can explain credits to procurement.
sam: For owners — propose CS: Marta, Eng: Ben, Observability: Priya (cc). Who owns final zip?
marta: CS will own delivery, Eng owns validation. @ben please drop validation checklist in thread.
ben: Will do. Plan: v1 bundle by EOD tomorrow. If anything blocks, ping here.
marta: Thanks. Quick follow-ups: 1) can we add a synthetic test screenshot? 2) add list of recent canaries used.
sam: I can export screenshot and canary names. Uploading to shared drive link: https://redwood.share/astermed-evidence
marta: perfect. closing loop — will schedule pre-renewal walkthrough with customer ops after we have bundle. :thumbsup:
